description: make train's stages (the Makefile's $(TRAIN_DIR)/<stage>.done targets) for the training dashboard: each stage's group, what it runs on (cpu, gpu - one at a time under the GPU lock - or network), the stages it needs (data dependencies), the stages it runs after (ordering only - Make's order-only prerequisites: the CPU checks scheduled into the teacher's GPU-bound hours), its expected minutes (quiet M3 Max, the corpora downloaded once), the training run it writes ($(TRAIN_DIR)/runs/<run>/ - its data/nn/train.json section, whose stop ends it early), and for a listening samples stage, the stage whose model it renders (samples - $(TRAIN_DIR)/samples/index.json's stage; reference: the shipped model); test/testTrainStages.js keeps it in sync with the Makefile

stages.title: The corpora - CMU ARCTIC, LibriTTS-R and its alignments, CREMA-D (downloads, once)
The heteronym relabeling, checked to reproduce data/nn/g2p-relabel.json
The readers' training data (picovox_train.multi build - every core)
The emotional speech's alignment (picovox_train.cremad align)
The emotional speech's training data (picovox_train.cremad build)
The G2P network's four stages (picovox_train.g2p train - one core, deterministic)
The heteronym context labels (the pinned books, aligned readings, part-of-speech tags)
The context network and its cross-validated held-out gate (picovox_train.context train-context, cross-validate)
The context G2P - the reading stage, the export, and picovox_train.context check against the committed module
Teacher stage A (picovox_train.trainmulti --recipe teacher.a - 15,000 steps)
Teacher stage B with the critic (picovox_train.trainmulti --recipe teacher.b - 20,000 steps)
The teacher through the listener panel (picovox_train.distill eval)
The distillation targets (picovox_train.distill targets)
The distilled student (picovox_train.distill train)
The student's polish on real audio (picovox_train.distill polish)
The student through the panel, and the gate (picovox_train.distill pick: within the teacher's tolerance)
lib/models/voiceModel.js with its provenance (picovox_train.export, picovox_train.package)
The shipped model's samples - lib/models/voiceModel.js before the package stage replaces it (tools/trainsamples.js)
Teacher A's samples - its final checkpoint (tools/trainsamples.js)
Teacher B's samples - its best checkpoint (tools/trainsamples.js)
The student's samples - its best checkpoint, before the polish (tools/trainsamples.js)
The polished student's samples - the model the package stage ships (tools/trainsamples.js)
